summary: Aureus Greenway Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a First Amendment to its Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Autonomous Power Corporation. The amendment increases the earn-out shares from 50,000,000 to 55,000,000 shares of Parent Common Stock, all fully vested and non-contingent at closing, removing all performance conditions. The original exchange ratio of 599.18229 remains unchanged. The merger will result in Target surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. No price per share, premium, or advisor is named. The structural change accelerates earn-out consideration, aligning Target stockholders' interests immediately. Watch for Nasdaq listing requirements and shareholder approval; risk-arb focus is on deal certainty and stock consideration valuation.
